_source: Our own table: the recipes of IV's hot cell, gtceu:hot_cell (docs/eras/iv.md, 'Hot cell', and 'Decisions taken with the raise', decisions 7 and 10). Modes 1 and 4 are composed from GTM's live recipes (the plans below name them; the numbers are read from the loaded pack at every load). Modes 2 and 3 are ours. Real processes: UF6 enrichment, MOX fuel, metallic production fuel in Zircaloy (Hanford N reactor), PuO2 heat sources in Pt-30Rh cladding (LWRHU), PuBe13 neutron sources in double steel capsules, PUREX reprocessing (Savannah River, La Hague) with vitrified high-level waste and nitric acid recovered from the NOx off-gas.
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/iv/hot_cell.js at every server load (a /reload picks up changes). Each entry becomes one gtceu:hot_cell recipe, id grindless:hot_cell/<name> (GTM's builder puts the type in front). The smoke test gg_test_hot_cell.js checks the live recipes against this table.

The programmed circuit is the mode: 1 enrichment, 2 fuel, 3 reprocessing, 4 radon. Inside a mode every recipe has its own inputs (GTM's recipe lookup keeps one recipe per set of ingredients, counts ignored, and a recipe whose ingredients are a subset of another's can hide it): no recipe of the type may take a subset of another's ingredients.

composed[]: server_scripts/grindless/lib/compose.js reads `stages` from the loaded recipes, uses up `given` (the batch) and nets every `linked` key to zero (keys: 'i:<item>' or 'f:<fluid>'). The recipe takes and gives what the whole line takes and gives, with the energy of every stage summed and spent at maxEUt (ceil(energy / maxEUt) ticks). Enrichment: UF6 never leaves and the fluorine the hexafluoride step needs comes back from the electrolyses, so HF goes in and the same fluorine comes out as F2 (decision 10: the hot cell converts HF into F2 and creates none). Radon: GTM's 8 plutonium ingots come back as dust and are smelted back (the electric furnace's EU), so they stay inside as a catalyst and no plutonium is needed.
recipes[]: ours, at eut x duration. itemsIn / itemsOut: { id, count, chance? } (chance of 10000; an output with a chance is a chanced output); fluidsIn / fluidsOut: { id, amount } in mB.

Plutonium balance (gtceu:plutonium_dust is GTM's Pu-239): a spent LEU or MOX assembly returns 1 Pu and 8 U-238; a MOX assembly takes 2 Pu (net -1 Pu per MOX); a breeder takes 1 Pu ingot and its spent assembly returns 2 Pu (net +1). An RTG pellet and a Pu-Be source take 1 Pu each.

The radioactive waste (gtnn:radioactive_waste: the fission products glassed with the chopped cladding) is contained: it leaves through the output bus and the hot cell refuses voiding. The NO2 goes to GTM's nitric acid recipes (2 NO2 + water + O2 -> 2 HNO3).
